description: List missions in the caller's accessible projects, newest activity first, with total for paging. Each has issueId, title, activity (what it does now), pipelineProgress, review/check/test state, PR, cost and paused. Archived missions are left out. Requires the missions:read scope.

activity.description: Filter by what the mission does now

limit.description: Page size (default 25). Narrow with projectId, activity or search before raising it.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page

search.description: Match the issue id, title, owner or repository

name: list_missions
title: List missions
